key.name: delay
key.description: The number of seconds to wait before taking the screenshot.

key.name: save-directory
key.description: URI of the folder where screenshots are saved by default. If empty, the user's Pictures folder is used.

key.name: include-pointer
key.description: Include the mouse pointer in the screenshot.

key.name: default-file-type
key.description: The default file type extension for saved screenshots.

key.name: include-shadow
key.description: Include the shadow when taking a window screenshot.

key.name: launch-file-manager-after-save
key.description: When enabled, opens the file manager with the saved screenshot pre-selected after a successful save.

key.name: autosave-to-file
key.description: When enabled, saves the screenshot to file without showing the application's interactive window

key.name: autosave-to-clipboard
key.summary: Copy saved screenshots to the clipboard
key.description: When enabled, a copy of every screenshot that is saved to a file is also placed on the clipboard.

key.name: use-flash
key.description: When enabled, a brief flash is shown over the captured area after taking a screenshot.
